jobs.title: BPM & Automation Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
We bring together AI expertise, engineering excellence and in-depth industry knowledge – driven by people who want to make a difference together. This leads to future-proof solutions that genuinely make a difference in our customers’ everyday lives. We achieve this through people who take responsibility, recognise opportunities and turn technological possibilities into tangible results. To this end, we create an environment characterised by mutual support: opportunities for professional development, open communities where knowledge is readily shared, peer groups and training programmes tailored to your needs. Trust, appreciation and successes celebrated together shape the way we work together and make personal development an integral part of our culture.

What You Can Move

Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for automation and optimization.
Model business processes using BPMN 2.0 and, where relevant, DMN and CMMN.
Design, configure and develop workflows on Flowable, Camunda or similar BPM platforms.
Implement process logic, forms, business rules, service tasks and integrations. Integrate BPM solutions with existing applications and IT landscapes using REST APIs and other web services.
Work with relational databases and SQL to support process-related data requirements.
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, subject-matter experts, architects and development teams.
Translate business requirements into robust, maintainable and scalable technical solutions.
Write readable, testable and maintainable code, following clean-code principles.
Contribute to testing, deployment, documentation and the ongoing support of automation solutions.
Participate in Agile delivery teams and contribute to continuous improvement.
Stay up to date with developments in BPM, workflow automation, hyperautomation and related technologies.

How You Succeed

Good practical knowledge of BPMN 2.0; experience with DMN or CMMN is an advantage.
Experience with process analysis, workflow modeling and the implementation of automated business processes.
Solid understanding of RESTful web services and experience working with JSON and/or XML.
Practical experience with SQL and relational databases.
Experience with Git or another version-control system.
Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
A degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional training and experience.
Full professional proficiency in French and English
An agile mindset, strong analytical skills and a structured way of working.
Good communication and collaboration skills, with confidence when interacting with both technical and business stakeholders.
Customer-oriented, proactive and motivated to learn and develop in a growing Business Automation team.

Nice to have

2 years of professional experience in BPM, workflow automation, software engineering, business analysis or a comparable field.
Experience developing with Java and Spring Boot.
Experience with Flowable, Camunda, Appian, Appway, IBM Business Automation Workflow, UiPath or similar platforms.
Familiarity with JavaScript and modern web technologies.
Experience with Docker and CI/CD practices.
Knowledge of Agile methods such as Scrum, Kanban or SAFe.
Interest in hyperautomation, AI-supported process automation or agentic automation.
Relevant certifications in Flowable, Camunda or another BPM platform.

Opportunity Giver – What Makes Adesso Special

Our promise: You will feel at home with us! Collegial, collaborative and on an equal footing - we live exchange, team spirit and respectful interaction. We value diversity and different perspectives just as much as you as a person. This and much more stands for our very special sense of togetherness. There's even a word for it: adessi.

Learn and grow with us: we support your continuous development with over 400 training courses and our digital learning platform.
Experience real team spirit: joint events (e.g. sport weekend and the annual eduCamp training trip), welcome days and company runs strengthen our team spirit and allow you to be part of the team from the very beginning.
Commitment that is rewarded: Your commitment pays off - with bonuses for recommendations, lectures, thesis supervision and attractive benefits via our corporate benefits portal.

Our culture and the way we work together are characterized by mutual appreciation, recognition and support. This unites us - even when working from home. Part-time work is possible by arrangement (80-100%). We have once again been voted one of the best employers in Switzerland! Our extensive training program and a transparent career level model for everyone ensure that your development with us never stands still. Because growing together and creating opportunities is programmed into our DNA.

CONTACT

You will like it here with us! Apply now directly online by clicking the blue button below.

Analysing detailed business/functional/technical requirements and specifications for the application and configuration of the end user applications and/or system

Your background

Strong problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

Effective in task prioritization, user collaboration, training, and documentation.

Strategic & Continuous Improvement Mindset: Skilled in strategic thinking and committed to ongoing improvement.

More About Us

For this role, depending on grade and experience we offer the following employee benefits (subject to the respective plan rules): Annual Incentive Plan, Flexible Working, Meal Allowance, Life Insurance, Medical Check-up, Psychological assistance, Language trainings, Coaching & Assessments.

jobs.title: Integration Support Specialist
jobs.description:
AppXite is a digital marketplace, CPQ and Billing platform for Telco, SaaS, Cloud and AI services enabling partners to build and monetize as-a-services offerings with flexible pricing models like Pay-Go, peak usage, reservations, pay per token, per outcome delivered or AI compute. Platform capabilities include pre-built vendor and catalog integrations with Microsoft, Google, AWS, Adobe, VMware and other worlds largest vendors.

Job Description:

We are seeking a dedicated Integration Support Specialist to work with our largest global customers. You will receive initial training on our platform, but you should already have the qualifications required for the role. As an Integration Support Specialist
, you will provide technical support focused on API integrations, database operations, and platform connectivity. You will investigate and resolve integration-related issues, support customer environments and data flows, and work closely with internal engineering teams to ensure seamless integrations and high service quality across the platform.

We offer a fully remote position with long-term cooperation, and working hours aligned with the EMEA time zone.

Your Mission:

Provide technical support and troubleshooting for API integrations, database connectivity, and data exchange between systems.
Investigate and resolve integration failures, API errors, and data inconsistencies by analyzing logs, API responses, and database records.
Write, optimize, and execute SQL queries to diagnose issues, extract data, and support integration workflows.
Work with RESTful APIs and webhooks — testing endpoints, interpreting payloads, debugging authentication and authorization issues.
Scope integration issues by collecting relevant facts, reproducing problems, and involving engineering teams as needed.
Support and maintain integrations with Microsoft Cloud technologies and third-party systems.
Consult and collaborate with peers, management, and engineering across teams and regions to resolve service issues.
Act internally as a customer advocate, ensuring integration requirements are clearly communicated to product and engineering.
Document integration patterns, known issues, and troubleshooting procedures to improve the support experience and help colleagues.
Empower customers to understand integration capabilities, configure connections, and self-solve common integration issues.
Maintain a proactive approach to customer satisfaction, identifying risks to integration stability and managing expectations.
Take ownership of tasks, proactively follow up, and ensure fast resolution.

Your Qualifications, Skills & Experience:

Previous experience in technical/integration support in IT.
Strong SQL skills: ability to connect to databases, write complex queries, perform data analysis, and troubleshoot data-level issues (MS SQL preferred).
Hands-on experience working with APIs — RESTful services, authentication methods (OAuth, API keys), request/response debugging, and API documentation (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI).
Experience with API testing tools such as Postman, Insomnia, or cURL.
Familiarity with data formats and protocols used in integrations (JSON, XML, HTTP, HTTPS).
Certified within the Azure and/or M365 certification roadmap (e.g., Azure Fundamentals, Azure Administrator, Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals or Associate level).
Fluent English (verbal and written).
Experience with Microsoft Cloud technologies (Azure).
Experience troubleshooting SaaS application integrations is a plus.
Experience with ETL processes or data migration is a plus.
Experience with scripting (PowerShell, Python) for automation or data manipulation is a plus.
Experience with licensing and invoicing systems is a plus.
Experience with MS Partner Center or similar administrator portals is a plus.
Ability to identify, update, and create Help Center articles on integration topics.
Ability to work well as part of a team.
Ability to make quick decisions, align priorities, and execute tasks.
Ability to stay calm under pressure.
Ability to communicate clearly and precisely, especially when translating technical integration details for non-technical stakeholders.

Why join AppXite:

Remote-First Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a fully remote role, or choose to work from our Latvia office.
Work With Global Tech Leaders: Collaborate on solutions used by some of the biggest names in the industry, including Adobe, AWS, Cisco, Google, IBM, Microsoft, Lenovo, and Liquid. Your work will help shape how these companies deliver services across the globe.
Skilled, International Team: Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We value technical excellence, clear communication, and mutual support.
Professional Development: Advance your skills with access to Microsoft certifications and continuous learning opportunities tailored to your role.
Time to Recharge: Enjoy four weeks of paid vacation per year, plus paid public holidays.
Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team - our employee referral program recognizes and rewards your contributions.
